# dsh-plugins

Monorepo of plugins for **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)**. Each plugin is a separate
npm package with a `ds

h.bundle.patch` manifest, so plugins can be installed
**selectively** from a single repository and a

re **automatically** added to the
profile (no manual `cordis.patch.yml` editing).
## Structure

## Plugins
| Package | What it does |
| dsh-assembly-rewrite | Rewrite named system-prompt assembly inserts (tools, sections, contexts, va

riables) from config. |
| dsh-assembly-tools-prompt-strip | Drop the `tool:<name>` prose guidance se

ctions from the system prompt. |
| dsh-client-ui-archived-session-cleanup | Settings control to dele
te archived sessions older than N days, with a live preview (host remote service + browser section).

|
| dsh-client-ui-wider-chat | Widen the conversation output column to near-full width while keepin

g the composer card at its current width. |
| dsh-command-from-prompt | Generic "command = user prom

pt" slash-command plugin. |
| dsh-command-status-interrupt | A `/status` command that aborts the run
ning generation and asks the model for a progress report without opening a new turn or a user bubble

. |
| dsh-compaction-micro | Per-request trajectory re-composition. |
| dsh-host-prompt-variables-co
nfig | Register extra prompt variables so they can be referenced as `{{name}}` in any system-prompt

section. |
| dsh-loop-guard | One package, two plugin rows: a reasoning-loop guard and a repeat-patt

ern reminder, sharing an internal coordination module. |
| dsh-spill-policy | Replacement spill poli

cy: bound oversized model-facing tool results to a head/tail preview plus a spill notice. |
| dsh-pr

ovider-websearch-lightpanda | WebRuntime provider pair backed by the lightpanda MCP server. |
| dsh-

skill-from-tools | Tools stay directly invocable; one skill per tool holds full details. |
| dsh-too

l-filter-root-find | Gates tool calls that sweep the whole disk or home directory. |
| dsh-tool-mcp-
mutation-gate | MCP command filter that asks the user for confirmation before executing a server's m

utating tools. |
| dsh-tool-node | `node_run` / `node_npm` tools confined through the DSH sandbox se

am. |
| dsh-tool-python | `py_run` / `py_pip` tools over a per-workspace venv, with on-the-fly repai

r of a relocated venv. |
| dsh-tool-trajectory-recall | Model-facing same-session recall/search tool
s over the durable session log. |
## How it works
Each package declares in `package.json`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

and ships a `cordis.patch.yml` file (a YAML list of rows with `insert`).
The `dsh plugin --profile w

eb add <pkg>` command installs the package and, via
`reconcilePlugins`, **itself** adds it to `dsh.p

rofile.bundles` — the plugin is
activated without manual edits.
## Install (selective, local)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`pnpm add ./path` creates a symlink to the local folder — convenient for development.
## Install (external users)
[代码示例省略，未执行]

> **About `github:`:** the `github:` protocol installs the repository root by
> default. To install

a single plugin from this monorepo, point at its
> subdirectory with `#path:packages/<name>` (as sho

wn above). For the most
> selective install from one repo, publish the packages to npm
> (`pnpm -r p
ublish`) and install by name.
## Publishing
[代码示例省略，未执行]
npm versions should match git tags `vX.Y.Z`.
## Adding a new plugin

1. Copy `packages/dsh-plugin-a` → `packages/dsh-plugin-<name>`.
2. Change `name` (scope `@blake-r/ds

h-<name>`), `version`, `description`.
3. Write the logic in `src/index.js` (ESM, export `name` + `ap

ply(ctx)`).
4. Update `cordis.patch.yml` (row id and name).
5. `pnpm check` and `pnpm -r publish`.
## Notes

- Plugin files are ESM (`.mjs`); check with `node --check`.
- The package's `cordis.patch.yml` must
be in `files` (otherwise it won't be published).
